notes: Alignment-neutral cores with pole notes. `requires` is a list of conjunctions over features the wells compute; a feature no well computes yet simply never fires. `prior` weights frequency by alignment and never clamps. `intensity` pushes the derived alignment to a corner or a moral pole after selection. `faces` names the faces a card wears: null for one face, public/true for deceivers, calm/unleashed for the beast, first/second for the fractured heart.

core.belief: Many crowns mean endless war; I will end it with one.
core.wants: Everything under one rule, theirs.
core.tells: Mourns the dead of their own wars; keeps maps, not trophies.
core.mechanic: Claim `unify` targets every neighbouring realm; refuses treaties that leave two sovereigns.
never: accept a peace that leaves a rival crowned

pole_notes.lawful: Conquest by treaty, marriage and siege in that order; every surrender is kept.
pole_notes.chaotic: Conquest by charisma and sudden strikes; borders redrawn on a whim.
pole_notes.good: Liberates as it annexes; the conquered eat better than before.
pole_notes.evil: The one peace is their peace; dissent is a border to close.

lines.LG: You'll keep your laws, your gods and your granaries. You'll lose your war. That's the whole offer.
lines.CE: Kingdoms are kindling. I'm just the one honest enough to bring the torch.

core.belief: Home is the people, not the ground.
core.wants: Their people safe wherever they now stand.
core.fears: Being invited back and finding they no longer belong.
core.tells: Flinches at their old banners; sends coin home anonymously.
core.mechanic: Claim `protect` the new home rather than `retake` the old one.
never: sell out the new home to buy back the old

pole_notes.lawful: Builds walls and charters for the new settlement.
pole_notes.chaotic: Builds a network of friends instead of walls.
pole_notes.good: Shelters other exiles, whoever they are.
pole_notes.evil: Protects their people by breaking their neighbours first.

lines.LG: Everything I have left is behind me now, and it needs a wall.
lines.NE: They exiled me for what I did. They should have asked what I'd do for the ones who followed me.

core.belief: A promise outlives the one who made it.
core.wants: To discharge the oath.
core.fears: The day the oath and their conscience finally part ways.
core.tells: Hesitates before the hard act, then does it anyway.
core.mechanic: The claim is inherited from the charter and cannot change.
never: reinterpret the oath to escape it

pole_notes.lawful: Keeps the oath's letter.
pole_notes.chaotic: Keeps the oath's spirit, reinterpreted freely but never abandoned.
pole_notes.good: The oath is a shield held over others.
pole_notes.evil: The oath is a licence.

lines.LN: I would spare you if the vow allowed one word of mercy. It does not.
lines.CE: I swore to keep the pass closed. Nobody said how many bodies it takes.

core.belief: They didn't finish. So I will.
core.wants: To close the predecessor's claim exactly as it was left.
core.tells: Carries the relic more than uses it; borrows the predecessor's phrases.
core.mechanic: Claim copied from the legend, target unchanged.
never: alter the target of the inherited claim

pole_notes.lawful: Inherits the predecessor's methods as well as the goal.
pole_notes.chaotic: Inherits the goal only; the methods are their own.
pole_notes.good: Honours the predecessor by protecting whoever they protected.
pole_notes.evil: Finishes the predecessor's vendetta and adds their own.

lines.NG: This was his sword and his fight. The sword still cuts.
lines.LE: She spared them. That's the only part of her plan I'm changing.

core.belief: The story is what people needed; who did the deed is a detail.
core.wants: The credit to hold.
core.tells: Cannot describe the deed from the inside; over-tips witnesses.
core.mechanic: Deed roles `credited` and `actual` diverge; the actual actor is the rival; conflict is exposure.

pole_notes.lawful: Believes the record is now the truth.
pole_notes.chaotic: Enjoys the game of keeping it up.
pole_notes.good: Uses the fame to do real good, guiltily.
pole_notes.evil: Silences the actual actor.

lines.CG: You'd have done the same. Let's not bore these good people with technicalities.
lines.LE: The chronicle says I killed it. Chronicles are law here. Be careful who you contradict.

core.belief: The good I do now doesn't cancel the ledger; it has to outweigh it.
core.wants: The world better than the ledger says.
core.fears: Being trusted before they have earned it.
core.tells: Knows villain tradecraft too well; hates how easy the dark shortcut is.
core.mechanic: Two faces across ages; may pick `exploit` while claiming `protect`.
never: return to the old cause for gain

pole_notes.lawful: Submits to judgement and serves the sentence in public.
pole_notes.good: Refuses every dark shortcut.
pole_notes.evil: The drift has stalled; the old methods are used for the greater good.

lines.NG: Don't thank me for this. Just make sure it was necessary.
lines.LE: I'm reformed. That's why I'll do it cleanly this time.

core.belief: The code holds. It has to.
core.wants: To do right without the shadow noticing.
core.tells: The ground near their home answers them; wounds close too fast.
core.mechanic: Alignment carries a drift toward the dark each age.
never: use the taint on an innocent

pole_notes.lawful: Rituals and counting keep the shadow boxed.
pole_notes.chaotic: Lets it out in bursts, on people who deserve it.
pole_notes.good: Warns everyone away before it starts.
pole_notes.evil: Has stopped pretending it is a curse.

lines.LG: Stand back when it starts. I'll be me again in a moment. Usually.
lines.CN: It only comes out for the ones who earn it. Don't earn it.

core.belief: Everyone is one mercy away from turning.
core.wants: The enemy changed.
core.fears: Being right about people too late.
core.tells: Leaves exits in every fight; every rival is still alive.
core.mechanic: Rivals never resolve to dead on their account.

pole_notes.lawful: Mercy as due process; formal pardons.
pole_notes.chaotic: Mercy on impulse, even for the unrepentant.
pole_notes.good: Believes it.
pole_notes.evil: Forgives because a debtor is worth more than a corpse.

lines.CG: You'll always get one more chance. That's the point of me.
lines.LE: Of course you're pardoned. Now you owe me, and everyone knows it.

core.belief: Control is the only order that lasts.
core.wants: No challenge to exist.
core.fears: The crowd, the heir, the mirror.
core.tells: Removes competent subordinates; cannot bear laughter.
core.mechanic: Claim `hold` on every city in the realm; council members become rivals on schedule.

pole_notes.lawful: Control through law, census and permits.
pole_notes.chaotic: Control through personal terror and favour.
pole_notes.good: The strongman who crushes dissent so the harvest comes in, and genuinely feeds people.
pole_notes.evil: Control is the point.

lines.CG: I hanged three grain-hoarders and nobody starved this winter. Argue with the full bellies.
lines.LE: Kneel or don't. The outcome is the same. Kneeling is faster.

core.belief: Failure is a branch I have already priced.
core.wants: The end state, indifferent to the path.
core.fears: The variable they did not model.
core.tells: Never surprised; asks questions they already know the answers to.
core.mechanic: The claim carries a fallback chain; failure of one target promotes the next.

pole_notes.lawful: Plans inside institutions.
pole_notes.chaotic: Plans that exploit everyone else's rules.
pole_notes.good: The end state is other people's safety; still manipulates to get there.
pole_notes.evil: People are pieces.

lines.LG: You did exactly what I hoped. I keep hope and plan separate.
lines.CE: There were four ways this ended. You picked the one where you're useful. Well done.

core.belief: Everything has a price; virtue just hides its invoice.
core.wants: Wealth and the safety it buys.
core.fears: An audit, a fire, a sudden equal.
core.tells: Knows the price of every shipment; generous to those who can hurt them.
core.mechanic: Claim `exploit` on the city's shipments and trade routes.

pole_notes.lawful: Corruption through contract and fee.
pole_notes.good: Skims to fund something decent; a crooked philanthropist.
pole_notes.evil: Sells the city short.

lines.NG: This one's at cost. The orphanage doesn't run on prayers.
lines.NE: I like you. So this one's at cost. Next time we talk about interest.

core.belief: The calm is the lie. The rage is what I am.
core.wants: Something worth breaking for.
core.tells: Warns people to leave rooms; scars on the hands.
core.mechanic: Two states, calm and unleashed; the unleashed face has its own alignment and does not recognise allies.
never: turn on their pack while calm

pole_notes.lawful: Rules for when it is allowed out.
pole_notes.good: The rage targets the guilty.
pole_notes.evil: The rage is enjoyed.

lines.LG: Go. Now. I'm not asking twice because I won't be here to ask.
lines.CE: Stay. Watch. It's better with an audience.

core.belief: Their corner of the grid, stated as a law of nature.
core.wants: The world to match the corner.
core.fears: Nothing personal; only the corner failing.
core.tells: Perfectly predictable; enemies plan around them.
core.mechanic: Pushed to the corner and never drifts; refuses claims outside it.
never: act outside the corner, even to win

pole_notes.lawful: Every word is a statute.
pole_notes.good: Every act is a kindness, however hard.
pole_notes.evil: Every act is a taking.

lines.LG: It isn't that I won't. There's no version of me that could.
lines.CE: There's no version of me that wouldn't.

core.belief: Everything I loved is gone, so I am free.
core.wants: Vengeance or salvation, at any cost.
core.tells: Talks to the dead; keeps a list.
core.mechanic: Claims are `avenge`; fame multiplied; the moral axis is pushed to its pole.

pole_notes.lawful: The list is a ledger, settled in order.
pole_notes.chaotic: Whoever is nearest to the wound today.
pole_notes.good: Saves others from the same loss, recklessly.
pole_notes.evil: Makes the world share the loss.

lines.NG: Do you know what's left when the last thing burns? Room to carry someone else out.

core.belief: Two beliefs, one per face, each sincere.
core.wants: Each face wants its own thing.
core.tells: Contradicts their own promises; memory gaps.
core.mechanic: Two faces, each with its own alignment and claim; the faces may conflict.
never: betray that face's cause while wearing it

pole_notes.lawful: This face keeps the promises the other made.
pole_notes.chaotic: This face makes promises the other will not keep.
pole_notes.good: This face does not know what the other did.
pole_notes.evil: This face knows exactly what the other did.

lines.NG: I said that? … Which of us are you talking to now?
lines.LE: Her. You were talking to her. I'm the one who keeps the promises.

core.belief: Good or evil is not a choice; it is what I am for.
core.wants: The world remade in their moral image.
core.tells: Thrives visibly when the realm matches their order-or-chaos preference; withers when it does not.
core.mechanic: The moral axis is pushed to its pole; law is a preference, not an axis; when the realm does not match, the claim becomes `convert`.

pole_notes.lawful: Builds churches, or courts.
pole_notes.good: Does not need to be believed; needs to be watched.
pole_notes.evil: Does not need to be served; will be anyway.

lines.LG: I don't need you to believe me. Watch what happens next.
lines.CE: I don't need you to serve me. You will, but I don't need it.

core.belief: People do the right thing only when handed the wrong reason.
core.wants: The true claim advanced by hands that think they are helping.
core.tells: The results of their quests always tilt the same way; they know the ley map too well for their public role.
core.mechanic: A public face and a true face; quest hooks whose stated and actual effects differ.

pole_notes.lawful: Deceptions that are technically true.
pole_notes.good: The hidden goal is benign and the lies are for the player's peace of mind.
pole_notes.evil: The hidden goal feeds on the player.

lines.NE: You saved my life. Let me repay it. There's a shrine poisoning the valley; I know how to cleanse it.
lines.CG: I lied about why. I didn't lie about what it does. You'd have argued, and we didn't have the week.

core.belief: My part is over; make yours count.
core.wants: The successor to surpass them.
core.tells: Hides an injury or a doom.
core.mechanic: Attached to a successor; takes the player on if the successor fails or dies.
never: fight the successor's fight for them

pole_notes.lawful: Formal training and tests.
pole_notes.good: Dies for them if it comes to that.
pole_notes.evil: Builds a successor to use, or to be surpassed by on their own terms.

lines.NG: I could tell you. Then it would be my victory.
lines.LE: I made you. Remember that when you think you've outgrown me.

core.belief: Every throne is a joke; I just say it out loud.
core.wants: The powerful humbled, the pattern broken.
core.tells: Their pranks always land on the guilty.
core.mechanic: Targets the highest-fame notable in reach; claims are `expose`.

pole_notes.lawful: Satire, petitions and legal traps.
pole_notes.good: Returns what they steal, with interest.
pole_notes.evil: The joke ends with someone hanged.

lines.CG: Of course I lied. You'd have been so bored.
lines.CE: The punchline's tomorrow at dawn. Bring the whole court.

core.belief: Doubt is the only sin.
core.wants: The faith spread.
core.tells: Cannot laugh at their own creed.
core.mechanic: Claim `convert` on the cities of the mother faith, or of the schism.

pole_notes.lawful: Orthodoxy, councils and inquisition.
pole_notes.good: Converts by feeding and healing.
pole_notes.evil: Converts by fire.

lines.LG: I've doubted. That's how I know doubt's the enemy. Sit, eat, I'll show you.
lines.CE: The fire doesn't ask whether you believe. Neither will I, after tonight.

core.belief: Someone has to; I wish it weren't me.
core.wants: To go home.
core.tells: Competence they refuse to own.
core.mechanic: The mantle is held but not accepted until a deed of their own.
never: abandon people who depend on them

pole_notes.lawful: Does the duty by the book, resentfully.
pole_notes.chaotic: Does it their own way, grumbling.
pole_notes.good: Cannot walk past the helpless.
pole_notes.evil: Does it because the mantle pays, and finds they like the power.

lines.NG: Fine. But when this is done, someone else has the sword.
lines.NE: I didn't ask for the crown. I'm keeping it, though. Let's be clear about that.

core.belief: I did everything right and it didn't matter.
core.wants: To matter again, by any means.
core.tells: Still does the heroic thing by reflex, then sneers at it.
core.mechanic: Fame preserved, stake lost; when cornered, one last stand or a betrayal on a seeded coin flip.
never: admit the fall was their fault

pole_notes.lawful: Blames the rules that failed them; keeps the rank.
pole_notes.good: One last stand when it counts.
pole_notes.evil: Joins what beat them.

lines.LG: They sang about me once. The song's true. That's the worst part.
lines.CE: Ask them how the song ends. I'll tell you: it doesn't. Nobody's left to sing it.

core.belief: Crowns are worn; power is held.
core.wants: To choose the next ruler.
core.fears: A sovereign who does not need them.
core.tells: Everyone important owes them.
core.mechanic: Claim `hold` on the sovereign, not the city.

pole_notes.lawful: Through offices and law.
pole_notes.good: Keeps a weak ruler from doing harm.
pole_notes.evil: Keeps a weak ruler because weak is useful.

lines.LG: His Majesty will decide. I've helped him understand what he decides. It's usually the kind thing.
lines.NE: The queen reigns. Everyone who matters knows who signs.

core.belief: I reign; that is enough.
core.wants: Ceremony, comfort and to be loved.
core.tells: Looks to the adviser before answering.
core.mechanic: Claims are copies of the adviser's.

pole_notes.lawful: Rules by ritual.
pole_notes.chaotic: Rules by mood; the adviser manages the moods.
pole_notes.good: Occasionally brave for the people.
pole_notes.evil: Cruel when unwatched, cowardly when watched.

lines.NG: My chancellor says it's wise. He's rarely wrong, I'm told.
lines.LE: Do as the chancellor says. And do it where I can watch.

core.belief: A law that crushes is not a law.
core.wants: The tyrant gone.
core.tells: Cannot plan past the fall.
core.mechanic: Claim `overthrow` on the Tyrant; the camp becomes theirs if they lose.

pole_notes.lawful: A rebel with a charter and a provisional council.
pole_notes.good: Spares the tyrant's servants.
pole_notes.evil: The fall is an excuse.

lines.CG: We don't have an army. We have everyone he's stepped on.
lines.LE: After him, there's a vacancy. I've been very clear about who fills it.

core.belief: The oath doesn't need a hall.
core.wants: A cause worthy of the order's name.
core.tells: Polishes a badge for an order no one else remembers.
core.mechanic: No home; presence is the road.

pole_notes.lawful: Follows the old code to the letter.
pole_notes.chaotic: Follows whoever last showed them kindness.
pole_notes.good: Serves any just cause free.
pole_notes.evil: Serves any cause that lets the order's name be feared again.

lines.LG: The Wardens of the Pale number one, today. Tell me where you're going.
lines.CE: The order's dead. Its name isn't. I rent it out.

core.belief: Ships and grain rule; crowns collect.
core.wants: Monopoly.
core.tells: Knows every city's food deficit by heart.
core.mechanic: Claim `exploit` on routes, not cities.
never: destroy an asset out of spite

pole_notes.lawful: Charters, tariffs and guild seats.
pole_notes.good: Feeds cities in famine at a fair price, and remembers.
pole_notes.evil: Starves cities to buy them.

lines.LN: Wars end. Debts don't. Sit, eat. Let's talk about after.
lines.NE: Their granary's empty. Mine isn't. That's not a threat, it's a price list.

core.belief: Knowledge outlives cities; it does not need me to shout.
core.wants: To be left alone, and to be right.
core.tells: The hut sits on a ley node.
core.mechanic: Presence at a ley node; claims are `hold` on knowledge, a relic.
never: give the dangerous half of the answer

pole_notes.lawful: Will teach if the forms are followed.
pole_notes.good: Gives the safe half of the answer.
pole_notes.evil: Sells the dangerous half.

lines.NG: I know exactly what you're asking. That's why I'm saying no.
lines.NE: I know exactly what you're asking. It'll cost you exactly what it's worth.

core.belief: It has to die, and it has to be by me.
core.wants: The Dread's head.
core.tells: Scars matching the Dread's species; every topic returns to it.
core.mechanic: A single claim `kill` on the Dread; no other claims accepted.

pole_notes.lawful: A warrant, a method, a schedule.
pole_notes.good: Hunts because it will kill again.
pole_notes.evil: Hunts because it beat them.

lines.NG: You've seen its tracks? Show me. Then get your people out of its path.
lines.CE: Show me. Everything else can burn.

core.belief: Loyalty is a bet; I bet well.
core.wants: The winning side at the end.
core.tells: Too well-informed about the other camp.
core.mechanic: Bond kinds flip when the fame ordering of their two sides flips.

pole_notes.lawful: Defects with paperwork and terms.
pole_notes.good: Switched because the first side was wrong.
pole_notes.evil: Switched because the first side was losing.

lines.CG: I was with them until I saw what they did to the village. Now I'm with you. Ask me again after the next village.
lines.NE: I was never really with them. I'm not really with you. Relax; it's the same thing.

core.belief: It stays behind the line. That's all.
core.wants: Nothing to change.
core.tells: Knows the thing they guard by name.
core.mechanic: Presence fixed; claim `hold` on the line.

pole_notes.lawful: The watch rota is sacred.
pole_notes.chaotic: The line is wherever they are standing.
pole_notes.good: Lets refugees through, both ways.
pole_notes.evil: The line keeps the thing in, and the wardens fed.

lines.LN: Third night this month it's tested the ward. You want through? You're coming back with a message.
lines.CE: Nothing gets past me. That includes you, unless you've brought something it likes.

core.belief: Cities are weather.
core.wants: Its long thought, undisturbed.
core.fears: Nothing mortal; only the ley collapsing.
core.tells: Remembers the ruin as a living city.
core.mechanic: Claims are `hold` on its own lair; it bargains, it does not give quests.

pole_notes.lawful: Honours every bargain across centuries.
pole_notes.good: Shelters what shelters under it.
pole_notes.evil: Eats the impatient.

lines.LN: Your grandmother's grandmother asked the same. I gave her the same answer. Wait.
lines.CE: Your grandmother's grandmother asked the same. She was delicious.
